rows.coder_note: Reference 33 (Liu 2015, DOI 10.1038/ng.3359) is the source of two dictionary rows (trans-ethnic, and European public summary statistics); the sentence carrying the citation and its two neighbours give no separating attribute (only an approximate 'more than 75,000 individuals'), and the European-descent statement stands in a Discussion sentence (p003) without the citation, so rule E's requirement that the attribute be in the pinned attribution sentence is not met; a consortium name alone identifies nothing (rule D).
